pages.text: Get in an automobile by right-clicking it, then use these controls to drive it.

pages.title: Keyboard
pages.text:
$(bold)W$() $(li1)Accelerate
$(bold)S$() $(li1)Brake / Reverse / Burnout
$(bold)A$() / $(bold)D$() $(li1)Steer left / right
$(bold)Space$() $(li1)Drift / Deploy attachment

pages.title: Controller (Controlify)
pages.text:
When using the Controlify mod, automobiles can also be driven with a controller:$(br)$(bold)A$() $(li1)Accelerate
$(bold)B$() $(li1)Brake / Reverse
$(bold)Left Stick$() $(li1)Steer left / right
$(bold)Right Trigger$() $(li1)Drift / Deploy attachment
